# Erik Eremenko — Software Developer

> Personal website of Erik Eremenko, who builds and runs software with AI coding agents. Information Systems student at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).

## About

Erik Eremenko is co-founder of PolySimulator (https://polysimulator.com), a paper-trading simulator and trading API for Polymarket with 7,000+ registered accounts. Since May 2026 nearly all of its code has been written by AI coding agents that he orchestrates with Claude Code and Codex. He is a working student in AI Workplace Assistance at ING Deutschland and studies Information Systems (Wirtschaftsinformatik) at TUM, after six semesters of Computer Science.
